label: V-SOL V2801F GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT built into an SFP module (Realtek RTL9601CI, Linux Luna SDK, SC/APC BOSA) that presents itself to the host router as an SGMII Ethernet interface at 1 Gbit/s only (no 2.5 Gbit/s HSGMII); GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over its web UI or SSH.
